title: Cosy Cable Sweater
description: A classic, warm sweater featuring a central cable panel on the body and sleeves. Knitted from the bottom up in pieces and seamed, this is a wonderful project for knitters ready to take their first steps into cabling. Fits sizes XS–XL with simple adjustments.
yarnRequirements: 500–700g Worsted weight yarn, depending on size (approx. 1000–1400m). Shown in oatmeal.
gauge: 18 sts × 24 rows = 10 cm in stocking stitch on 5 mm needles
materials: 500–700g Worsted weight wool or wool-blend yarn
5 mm straight or circular needles (60 cm)

instructions.title: Back Panel
instructions.body: Cast on 82 (90, 98) sts. Work 2×2 rib for 6 cm. Change to stocking stitch and work even until piece measures 38 cm from cast-on. Shape armholes: cast off 4 sts at beg of next 2 rows, then dec 1 st each end EOR 3 times. Continue until armhole measures 22 cm. Place sts on holder.

instructions.title: Front Panel with Cable
instructions.body: Cast on 82 (90, 98) sts. Work 2×2 rib for 6 cm. Set up cable panel: work 28 (32, 36) sts in st st, 26 sts in cable panel (see chart), 28 (32, 36) sts in st st. Cable panel: rounds 1–5 knit; round 6: sl6 to cable needle, hold front, k6, k6 from cable needle, k14. Repeat this 6-row cable every 6 rows. Shape armholes as for back.

instructions.title: Sleeves (Make 2)
instructions.body: Cast on 42 sts. Work 2×2 rib for 5 cm. Increase 1 st each end every 8th row until you have 64 sts. Work even until sleeve measures 47 cm. Shape sleeve cap: cast off 4 sts each end, dec 1 st each end EOR 10 times, cast off remaining sts.

instructions.title: Neckband
instructions.body: Join shoulder seams. With circular needles, pick up and knit approx 90 sts around neckline. Work 2×2 rib for 4 cm. Cast off loosely in rib.

instructions.title: Finishing & Seaming
instructions.body: Set in sleeves using mattress stitch. Join side seams and sleeve seams. Weave in all ends on the wrong side. Block the finished sweater by soaking in cool water, pressing gently in a towel, and drying flat to measurements.

reviews.author: olivia.banks
reviews.body: Best pattern i've bought this year, the cable panel came out even better than the photos. Worth every penny!

reviews.author: knitandpurl99
reviews.body: Really good pattern overall but the sizing chart was a little confusing - had to measure myself a few times to be sure which size to go for. Sweater came out great though once I figured it out!

reviews.author: HeatherM
reviews.body: Made this twice now - one for me and one for my daughter. Perfect for winter. Both fit beautifully.

reviews.author: mark_t
reviews.body: Not quite what I expected tbh - there are a couple of typos in the abbreviations section which threw me off for a bit. Still a nice knit once I figured out what they ment, but worth being aware of.

reviews.author: Cass_Knits
reviews.body: The cable panel is so satisfying to work. Instructions are well written and the progress photos in the PDF are really helpful.

reviews.author: janesmith_crafts
reviews.body: Lovely pattern. I went down a needle size from the suggestion as my tension runs loose and it ended up perfect. Would definately recommend.
